expectations.evidence: Step 1 adds `> /tmp/new-cert.json` and `cat /tmp/new-cert.json | jq -r '.data.certificate' > /etc/billing/tls/new.pem`, which the original never states, and the rollback adds `billingctl resume`, which the original only gives as a final step.

Step 3 "sudo cp /etc/billing/tls/current.pem /etc/billing/tls/previous.pem" runs before the swap in step 4, and the rollback runs "sudo cp /etc/billing/tls/previous.pem /etc/billing/tls/current.pem" then restarts billing-worker.
The 2024 Vault move history is dropped, and the only background is a one-line note on the 90-day validity and the alert timing, outside the steps.

Prerequisites, including the month-end warning, come before the Procedure. Each step has one action, and the backup (step 3) comes before the swap (step 4). Step 6 points to the Rollback section, which sits after step 7 but is clearly labeled.
